concept.title: Coaching, mentoring and skills learning
concept.shortdesc: Developing skills and personal progress through mentoring, coaching, skills sessions and online courses.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : One-to-one or programme-based mentoring where an experienced person guides and supports someone's development.
: One-to-one or group coaching, covering sports coaching for adults and juniors as well as life, job and money coaching.
: General skills development, including life skills, work skills, English and maths, and skill sharing.
: Courses, classes, webinars and events delivered online or virtually.
